newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Resources has gold finds.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Resources has gold finds.

text.p: Gold and copper miner Australian Resources Ltd said on Thursday that it continued to have exploration success in the vicinity of all three of its operating mines in the three months to September 30.

At Mt McClure, in Western Australia, drilling at the Anxiety Bore prospect had outlined a three km long anomalous zone with results including 22.0 metres at 28.01 grams per tonne (g/t) gold, the company said in its quarterly report.
Australian Resources holds 63.35 percent of the operation.
At the 100 percent owned Selwyn project in Queensland, drilling into and around the Corbould zone in Mt Elliott continued to produce excellent results, the company said.
Returns included 34 metres at 2.77 g/t gold, 6.35 percent copper and 9.9 metres at 2.88 g/t gold and 13.6 percent copper.
Initial drilling in the Kuridala joint venture area, adjacent to Selwyn, intersected multiple zones of sulphide mineralisation in two holes, Australian Resources said.

"At Gidgee (Western Australia), drilling within the Wyooda Thangoo area continues to produce encouraging results including six metres at 8.05 g/t gold and three metres at 12.4 g/t gold at Kingston Town," the report said.
"At Omega Deeps, results included 1.03 metres at 127.2 g/t gold and 1.54 metres at 84.04 g/t gold," it said.
"Further encouraging results were obtained over a strike length of 150 metres at the Psi Prospect, adjacent to Omega, including 6.6 metres at 10.34 g/t gold.
Chairman John Roberts said the results were very encouraging and supported the company's aggressive exploration strategy. Exploration expenditure totalled A$4.81 millionin the quarter.
The group's share of production for the quarter totalled 48,560 ounces of gold and 5,422 tonnes of copper compared with 50,054 ounces of gold and 5,728 tonnes of copper a year earlier.
Cash costs of gold per ounce were A$337 compared with A$328 a year earlier.
